description: List the car makes in the exotic rental catalog (nationwide, or in a state or city) with how many cars and companies offer each and the lowest published daily rate; with make, list that make's model families (Huracán, Urus, Aventador…). Use this when someone asks which brands or models they can rent somewhere, or to check how the catalog spells a make or model before calling search_vehicles. Unknown makes, states or cities return an empty list with did_you_mean.

city.description: city name as people say it (Miami, LA, Vegas, NYC)

make.description: a make to list its model families; omit to list the makes

state.description: US state: two-letter code, name or slug (FL, Florida, new-york)

name: browse_makes

as_of.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the catalog's last content change

title: Browse makes and model families
